'''Andria''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], she served as a [[Jedi Consular]] trainer in [[Farnel Outpost]] Command Center.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
